def r(x):
    x = float(x)
    t = 6.0 * x - 3.0
    t_perturbed = t + 0.1 * (3.0 - abs(t))  # move t toward ±3 asymptotic regime, preserving sign
    x_perturbed = (t_perturbed + 3.0) / 6.0
    return max(0.0, min(1.0, x_perturbed))

def R(y_orig, y_new):
    y_orig, y_new = float(y_orig), float(y_new)
    return y_new >= y_orig - 1e-6
